concurrency.concurrent_invoke_behavior: migrateSession acquires mkdir_exclusive at <target>/.svc/orchestration/.migrate-<session_id>.lock before reading the binding or appending session-contract. Holder that finds binding.wi+worktree_root match and !released_at loads .svc/orchestration/<wi>.migrate.json (or reconstructs the baton from the binding if the receipt is missing) and returns skipped_contract_append:true without retire/writeTargetBinding/appendSessionContract. Second concurrent caller waits, then takes the skip path. Binding JSON still uses atomic_rename. Distinct sessions use distinct lock dirs.
concurrency.stale_lock_cleanup: Lock dir older than 15 seconds is removed. Bindings are not locks; retire sets released_at. Orphan temp files matching *.tmp under .svc/bindings are unlinked if older than 15 minutes.

external_writer.read_failure_policy: abort the wirer rewrite and restore rolling_rollback; never proceed on an unreadable host config
external_writer.file_mode_preservation: copyPreservingMode already in scripts/wire-grok-hooks.mjs; Claude/Cursor JSON wirers keep existing mode on atomic rename

idempotent_rewriter.proof: AC-BIND-5 in validate-cross-repo-orch-02.mjs: second migrateSession of the same session+WI+worktree tuple returns skipped_contract_append and does not append session-contract; missing receipt reconstructs without append; two concurrent callers produce one contract line. Second wirer run is a no-op for an already-present svc-origin-orchestrator-prompt id and must not duplicate the hook or rewrite the immutable pre-migration backup.

resource_review.evidence: Census is the planned executable set (resolver, hook, three wirers, isolation guard, orch lib, 02 validator). Identity writer is migrateSession binding JSON only; no quota or money.

resource_writers.ordering: Resolve linked onboarded worktree and session-shaped id before any binding write; refuse default checkout and foreign session before rename.
resource_writers.compensation: Denied binds write nothing. Same-tuple retry returns existing baton. Origin binding retire happens only after target write via atomic rename of the origin file with released_at.
resource_writers.property_sweep: foreign deny, default-checkout deny, missing session id, same-tuple idempotent, mixed-repo Write still denied
